Remove Business

The Remove Business screen allows you to delete an existing business from Manager. To remove a business, select it from the dropdown menu and click the Remove Business button.

Remove Business

Data Safety

Manager does not permanently delete your data. When you remove a business, it is moved to the Trash folder within your data folder. This ensures your business data remains recoverable if needed.

Restoring Removed Businesses

To restore a previously removed business, navigate to the Trash folder in your data folder and move the business file back to the main data folder. The business will then appear in your business list again.

If you are using Cloud Edition, you cannot directly access the Trash folder because your data is stored in the cloud. To restore a removed business in Cloud Edition, visit https://cloud.manager.io, log in to your account, and click the Restore Business button.
